description: Parallel adoption map for Codex workflow orchestration capabilities in AgentNexLiFy.

workstreams.name: Address GitHub review comments
workstreams.notes: Treat review feedback as a first-class queue and resolve comments before merge handoff.

workstreams.name: Run multiple terminal tabs
workstreams.notes: Split execution into implementation, tests, and guardrails running in separate terminal sessions.

workstreams.name: SSH to remote devboxes
workstreams.notes: Route long-running or resource-heavy checks to remote environments when available.

workstreams.name: Preview PDFs, spreadsheets, slides, and docs
workstreams.notes: Use preview surfaces to review technical docs and product artifacts without leaving workflow context.

workstreams.name: Track plans, sources, and artifacts
workstreams.notes: Require every non-trivial task to keep plan, source, and artifact traceability current.

workstreams.name: Reuse existing conversation threads
workstreams.notes: Resume existing thread context when reopening multi-day initiatives.

workstreams.name: Schedule future work
workstreams.notes: Schedule follow-up checks and deferred implementation passes for long-running streams.

workstreams.name: Persistent memory for conventions and corrections
workstreams.notes: Store durable conventions and prior corrections so future tasks start with accurate context.
